BLOCKER: Declared affected_files is only `config/implementation-controls.json`, yet AC-2 requires `implementation_readiness_check` plus its tests; the checker script/test files are undeclared, so AC-2 cannot be delivered under this scope.

AC-1/AC-2 require named fail-closed cases (missing matrix, placeholder, missing symbol, tenant/concurrency) but design_pack.failure_matrix lists only `EVIDENCE_MISSING` and test_matrix has only two generic "focused tests" rows — the AC is not met as specified.

Language rule unaddressed: `implementation_readiness_check` is new shipped logic; design/verification imply pytest/Python without stating a tooling classification or Go implementation, risking a language-rule violation.
MAJOR: config_contract declares `N/A: no new config on develop` while affected_files adds `config/implementation-controls.json`; the config contract must be reconciled or the item fails the config spec gate.
CL-015 not satisfied: `ac_evidence` and `coverage` entries carry no candidate SHA, so Gate 2 evidence pinning will fail closed.

Design guardrails checklist (reversibility/backup, availability/SPoF, authz-RLS posture, blast-radius/dry-run, invariants/ordering, tenant isolation) is not answered in the design pack, contrary to CL-008 which requires it before Gate 1.5.

AC-1 requires positive/negative/tenant/concurrency test rows plus observability and evidence per AC, but the design has no per-AC row schema (symbol, test kinds, observability fields) and no definition of placeholder detection rules.
`affected_components: [config]` omits the readiness-checker component, so ownership, review routing, and reuse of existing gate/script owners are undefined.
MINOR: Observability is only "focused tests"; no log/metric or exit-code contract is specified for the checker, making production diagnosis of fail-closed runs difficult.
No schema/version field for `implementation-controls.json`, so future matrix evolution lacks a compatibility and migration path.
Rollback is "Revert the change" with no statement of how an interrupted/partial config edit is detected or recovered (checklist item 6).
Dependency on BI-PF-1540 and the assumption "develop has shared review decisions API" are unverified and carry no failure behavior if absent.
NIT: `out_of_scope`, `risks` are "Not specified" placeholders; fill them to keep the gate record self-describing.
test_matrix could name concrete test ids instead of "focused tests" for traceability.
SUMMARY: Verdict: not ready for Gate 1.5 — the approved ACs reference a checker and per-AC control rows that are absent from the declared file set, failure matrix, and test matrix.
Top risks: undeclared deliverable files (AC-2 unreachable), config-contract contradiction, unpinned evidence SHA, and unanswered design guardrails (CL-008/CL-015).
Re-check after the design declares the checker + tests, defines the control-row schema and placeholder rules, and pins evidence to a candidate SHA.
